title: User Authentication Success
description: Validate that users can successfully authenticate with valid credentials and gain access to protected routes.

steps.description: Navigate to login page
Input valid username/email and password
Submit login form
Check that authentication is successful and user is redirected to dashboard
Verify session token is created and stored securely
Verify access is permitted to protected routes

title: User Authentication Failure
description: Ensure authentication fails gracefully with invalid credentials without exposing sensitive information.

steps.description: Navigate to login page
Input invalid username/email or password
Submit login form
Check that authentication is denied
Verify error message is displayed appropriately and no session token is created

title: Session Management and Protected Routes Enforcement
description: Verify active session tokens grant access to protected routes and expired or invalid sessions redirect to login.

steps.description: Authenticate user and obtain session token
Access protected route with valid session token
Verify access is granted to protected route
Invalidate session token or simulate expiration
Attempt to access protected route again
Verify user is redirected to login page

title: Create New Shipment
description: Validate creation of a new shipment with detailed consignee and shipment information.

steps.description: Navigate to shipment creation page
Input valid consignee and shipment details including weight, destination, and contents
Submit the create shipment form
Verify shipment record is created successfully and visible in shipment list
Verify shipment status is set correctly and essential metadata is stored

title: Update Existing Shipment
description: Verify that users can update shipment details and that updates persist correctly.

steps.description: Locate an existing shipment from the shipment list
Edit shipment fields such as status, consignee address, or contents
Submit the update form
Confirm shipment details reflect the updated information

title: Cancel a Shipment
description: Verify users can cancel a shipment and system updates shipment status appropriately.

steps.description: Access a shipment eligible for cancellation
Submit cancellation request
Verify shipment status updates to 'Cancelled'
Confirm subsequent attempts to update canceled shipment are prevented

title: Bulk Shipment Search and Operations
description: Validate search functionality with multiple filters and bulk operations on selected shipments.

steps.description: Navigate to shipment management page
Perform searches using different filter criteria (date range, status, consignee, weight)
Verify search results match filter criteria accurately
Select multiple shipments from results list
Perform bulk update or cancellation on selected shipments
Confirm bulk operations apply successfully to all selected shipments

title: Manifest Creation and Lock Workflow
description: Verify creation of a manifest, locking shipments to manifest, and deny changes after lock.

steps.description: Create a new manifest with valid details
Assign multiple shipments to the manifest
Lock the manifest to prevent further changes
Confirm manifest status is updated to locked
Attempt to modify shipments in a locked manifest
Verify modifications are disallowed and relevant error messages are shown

title: Manifest Dispatch and Completion Workflow
description: Validate dispatch process, arrival logging, and marking the manifest as complete.

steps.description: Access a locked manifest ready for dispatch
Mark manifest as dispatched
Verify manifest status changes to dispatched
Log arrival time and conditions upon manifest arrival
Mark manifest as complete
Confirm manifest status updates to completed and is immutable thereafter

title: Customer CRUD Operations
description: Validate create, read, update, and delete operations for customer data including autocomplete search.

steps.description: Create a new customer with valid fields
Confirm customer is listed in customer management page
Use autocomplete search box to find customers by partial names or contacts
Verify autocomplete suggestions accurately match search input
Update customer details
Confirm updated details are saved and reflected
Delete a customer entry
Verify customer is removed and cannot be selected in operations

title: Invoice Creation and Status Workflow
description: Verify creating invoices linked to shipments or customers, editing, status transitions, and audit logging.

steps.description: Create invoice for selected shipment or customer order
Verify invoice is created with correct amount, tax details and statuses
Edit invoice details before finalization
Confirmed updated details are saved
Change invoice status through its allowed workflow (e.g., Draft → Issued → Paid)
Verify status changes are properly reflected and prevented if invalid
Validate audit logs record all changes and status transitions

title: Payment Processing with Razorpay Integration
description: Test end-to-end payment flows including payment creation, verification, and webhook processing.

steps.description: Generate payment request linked to an invoice
Simulate user completing payment via Razorpay
Verify payment status updates to confirmed and reflected in invoice
Trigger Razorpay webhook with valid payment event
Confirm webhook processes event accurately updating payment and invoice statuses
Trigger Razorpay webhook with invalid or tampered data
Verify webhook validation fails and error handling works gracefully

title: Real-Time Shipment Tracking Public Page
description: Validate that shipment statuses and event timelines are accurately displayed to public users using shipment references.

steps.description: Navigate to public tracking page
Input valid shipment reference or AWB number
Verify shipment status and full event timeline are displayed and updated in real-time
Input invalid or non-existent shipment reference
Verify appropriate error or not found message is displayed

title: Warehouse Inventory Count and Adjustment
description: Test inventory management including accurate counting, adjustments, and reflecting changes in balances.

steps.description: Access inventory management page
Record new inventory counts for selected SKU or warehouse location
Make adjustments such as adding or subtracting inventory quantities
Verify inventory balances reflect counts and adjustments correctly

title: Barcode Scanning for Shipment Processing
description: Validate barcode scanning functionality correctly identifies shipments and updates statuses accordingly.

steps.description: Access scanning module UI
Scan valid barcode linked to shipment
Verify shipment is identified correctly and related status or inventory updates are made
Attempt scanning invalid or unassigned barcode
Verify error message displayed and no updates performed

title: Notification Send and Audit Logging
description: Ensure email, SMS, and WhatsApp notifications are sent correctly with audit logs maintained.

steps.description: Trigger notification events for shipment status changes, invoice sent, or payment confirmation
Verify notifications are sent via appropriate channels (email, SMS, WhatsApp)
Confirm audit logs record all sent notifications with timestamps and delivery statuses

title: PDF Generation for Invoices and Labels
description: Verify PDF documents for invoices and shipping labels are generated correctly and downloadable via REST APIs.

steps.description: Request PDF generation for an invoice
Verify returned PDF document is valid, printable, and adheres to enterprise standards
Request shipping label PDF for a shipment
Confirm label PDF renders correctly with accurate shipment information
Invoke PDF generation API with invalid or missing parameters
Verify error responses are returned gracefully

title: Dashboard Analytics Overview Cards and Charts Accuracy
description: Validate dashboard analytics components render accurate KPIs and graphical data consistent with backend inputs.

steps.description: Access dashboard analytics page
Verify overview cards display correct totals and metrics
Verify charts render data accurately and update on filter changes

title: Security Headers and CORS Enforcement
description: Ensure production environment enforces strict security headers, CORS policies, and environment variable validation.

steps.description: Send requests to application endpoints in production environment
Verify security headers (CSP, HSTS, X-Frame-Options, etc.) are present and configured correctly
Verify CORS policies prevent unauthorized cross-origin requests
Check environment variable validation during startup
Confirm application startup fails or warns on invalid environment configuration

title: API Input Validation and Error Handling
description: Validate all RESTful API endpoints enforce strict input validation (via Zod schemas) and return standardized errors.

steps.description: Send API requests with valid payloads to shipments, manifests, customers, invoices, and payments endpoints
Verify successful responses with expected data
Send API requests with invalid or malformed payloads
Confirm standardized error responses with appropriate HTTP codes and messages

title: RLS Policies Prevent Cross-Tenant Data Access
description: Automated tests verify Row-Level Security policies scope data access correctly by organization to prevent cross-tenant leaks.

steps.description: Attempt to access shipment, manifest, customer, invoice, and payment data belonging to different organization tenant
Verify access is denied or no data returned
Access the same data as authorized tenant user
Confirm full access is granted to authorized user's organization's data

title: Performance: Page Load and Server Startup Metrics
description: Verify pages load under 2 seconds, bundle size is optimized, and server startup completes under 1 second.

steps.description: Measure load time of critical pages (dashboard, shipment list, invoice page)
Check load time does not exceed 2 seconds
Analyze bundled assets for size optimization
Verify bundle sizes comply with target thresholds
Restart server and measure startup time
Confirm server startup completes within 1 second

title: Audit Logs Verification for Critical Operations
description: Verify audit logs capture all critical operations including authentication events, invoice changes, payment status updates, and shipment lifecycle changes.

steps.description: Perform operations: login/logout, create/update/delete invoice, update payment status, change shipment status
Verify audit logs record who performed the operation, when, and what changed
Audit logs should be immutable and consistently available for review

title: Accessibility Compliance (WCAG AA) and UI Token Design Consistency
description: Validate UI components conform to accessibility standards and the OKLCH color token design system.

steps.description: Inspect key UI screens across the app for color contrast, keyboard navigability, screen reader compatibility
Verify accessibility audit tools report WCAG AA compliance
Compare UI color usage against token design system guidelines
Confirm consistency in color tokens and adherence to design tokens

title: Deployment Readiness Validation
description: Ensure database migrations succeed, environment configuration is validated, and code linting produces zero critical warnings.

steps.description: Run full deployment including applying all database migrations on staging environment
Verify migrations complete without errors
Validate environment variables and configuration during deployment
Confirm environment validation rejects missing or invalid configuration
Run linting and static code analysis tools
Ensure zero critical lint warnings or errors exist
